name: Typeface
task: choosing, pairing, setting or briefing a typeface: a text face for a book or a product, a display face for a title, or a type brief for a designer

vectors.label: Stroke contrast
vectors.low: monoline, thick and thin strokes equal
vectors.high: hairlines against heavy stems, 5:1 or more

vectors.label: Construction
vectors.low: written: broad-nib pen, diagonal stress, open forms
vectors.high: constructed: ruler and compass, vertical or no stress

vectors.label: x-height
vectors.low: small, under 0.62 of the cap height
vectors.high: large, 0.74 of the cap height or more
